Increasing the distance of an external focus of attention enhances learning
sources.authors: McNevin NH, Shea CH, Wulf G.

sources.title: Extrinsic feedback for motor learning after stroke: what is the evidence?
Enhancing the learning of sport skills through external-focus feedback
sources.authors: Wulf G, McConnel N, Gärtner M, Schwarz A.

findings.finding: An external focus of attention on the intended movement effect helps establish efficient functional connections across brain networks that support skilled movement.
findings.quote: Furthermore, we consider the influence of an external focus for the establishment of efficient functional connections across brain networks that subserve skilled movement.

findings.finding: Increasing the physical distance between the body and the external effect of the action can further enhance learning advantages.
findings.quote: The purpose of the present study was to test the hypothesis that increasing the distance between the body and the action effects might further enhance the learning advantages associated with an external focus of attention.

findings.finding: Instructions or feedback that induce an external focus of attention are generally more effective than those prompting an internal focus.
findings.quote: instructions or feedback inducing an external focus may be more effective than those with an internal focus.

findings.finding: Providing feedback that emphasizes movement effects leads to greater task accuracy than feedback that focuses on body movements.
findings.quote: External-focus feedback resulted in greater accuracy than internal-focus feedback did.

principle: Directing a learner's attention to the external effects of their movements rather than to the body movements themselves enhances motor learning and performance.
for_the_teacher: Instruct users to focus on the external effects of their movements rather than on how their body parts are moving.
Design feedback cues that direct attention further away from the user's body to promote more effective movement control.
